subject: Decision Making
title: Nominal Group Technique
description: A quick win: understand Nominal Group Technique.

hook.text: In the nominal group technique, everyone writes ideas silently before any discussion.

buildup.text: After silent writing, each person presents one idea at a time in round-robin format. No interruptions. No debates.

discovery.text: The group then discusses and ranks all ideas by secret vote. The structure ensures every voice is heard equally.

twist.text: Nominal groups consistently generate more and better ideas than traditional brainstorming in randomized controlled.

climax.text: Brainstorming feels creative but is not. Structured processes feel rigid but produce better output by protecting.

punchline.text: Write first, speak second, vote secretly. Structure beats free-flowing.

quiz.question: Why does nominal group technique outperform brainstorming?
options: Silent writing prevents anchoring and ensures every person's ideas are heard equally
